text: Android: list name/category order go stale; top bar shows 'List' not the list's name

Top-bar title detail: AppDrawerScaffold takes title as a plain String literal
from Nav.kt (param at Nav.kt:184; call sites pass "List"/"Registry"/"List
properties"). The ListViewModel that knows the name lives INSIDE the scaffold's
content lambda, not above it, so you can't just read it at the call site.
Cleanest options: (a) resolve the name in the Nav composable itself (it has
listId) via a small repo/VM read and pass it as title, or (b) drop the scaffold
title for list/registry/props and give those screens their own TopAppBar. For
the live-data part there's precedent: ListDao.activeLists() is already a Flow —
add observeById(id): Flow<ListEntity?> in parallel. Confirmed ListPropsViewModel
.init has the identical load-once staleness.
